setup: You are counting how many copies of \(\frac{[[in_num]]}{[[in_den]]}\) fit into \([[of]]\).

steps.say: Counting how many times a fraction fits into a whole number is a division: \([[of]]\) divided by \(\frac{[[in_num]]}{[[in_den]]}\).
Dividing by a fraction multiplies by its reciprocal, so the count is \([[of]] \times [[in_den]] / [[in_num]] = [[out_num]]\), a whole number because the fractions line up.
